description: Huawei 4G Mobile WiFi 5: no wired Ethernet. Wi-Fi 5, 2.4 GHz 300M. The 195 Mbps cellular uplink is a radio, not a socket - it resolves to the cellular cage and cannot be cabled. Single-band 2.4 GHz radio: the spec page lists no 5 GHz rate. Requested in #152; figures from https://consumer.huawei.com/en/routers/4g-mobile-wifi-5/specs/
label: HUAWEI 4G Mobile WiFi 5
